svg.text: Multi-stage build — build with everything, ship almost nothing
Why not just delete the compiler in a later RUN?
Because layers are immutable. A file deleted in layer 8 still exists in layer 4, and anyone with the image
can extract it. Deleting does not shrink an image and it does not remove a leaked credential.
A multi-stage build never puts those things in the final image at all. The builder stage is a separate
image that is thrown away, so there is no layer left holding what you did not want to ship.
